targets.S: L066 Theorem1.1, degrees N>=4, N!=6; exact published floor-sum count of unordered distinct commuting involution pairs up to Aut(S_N)
targets.A: L066 Theorem1.2, degrees N>=4, N!=6; exact published floor-sum count of unordered distinct commuting involution pairs up to Aut(A_N)

common_background_B: Elementary finite group theory, orbit-stabilizer and coset actions
Disjoint cycle decomposition and conjugacy by cycle type in S_N
Signs of permutations and elementary integer sum identities
C_S_N(a)=(C2 wreath S_k) times S_(N-2k) for an involution with k transpositions
Aut(S_N)=S_N and Aut(A_N)=S_N for N>=4, N!=6

source.title: On pairs of commuting involutions in Sym(n) and Alt(n)
source.extraction_recipe: For each zero-indexed page i: append newline, --- PDF PAGE i+1 ---, newline, page.extract_text() or empty, newline. Concatenate.

spans.locator: pp3–5, preliminary reduction and Lemmas3.2–3.3; excludes Remark3.4
pp7–8, alternating preliminary count and Lemma4.2

metrics.primary: NFKC-normalized non-whitespace Unicode codepoints after deleting only PDF page markers, exact running-header lines and soft hyphens
metrics.secondary: Unicode alphanumeric runs, [^\W_]+; extraction glues some words, so this is a token sensitivity count rather than clean linguistic word count
metrics.raw: UTF-8 bytes of selected raw proof spans, including local formatting

accounting.overlap_policy: Reject overlapping spans; union of primary spans defines total. Optional source exposition is reported separately and never charged silently.
accounting.statement_policy: Target statements outside proof spans excluded on both sides; internal lemma statements and displayed equations inside proof arguments included
accounting.source_proposition_4_1: Optional sensitivity span, excluded from conservative primary numerator. Its order formula is unused; Lemma4.2 repeats the needed centralizer-even-part equality, which also follows directly from common background.
accounting.replacement_extra_dependencies: None beyond B; all counting identities proved in selected spans
excluded_from_proof_length: Existing finite GAP certificate, not used for these targets
Existing formula comparison scripts, not used to prove equivalence

limitations: Description-length measurement of specified proofs, not shortest proofs or importance
Conditional on explicit unexpanded common background B
PDF extraction affects token counts; character metric is insensitive to missing spaces but not every extraction error
No copyrighted source text or page images distributed
Source typeset glyphs and replacement plain Unicode/ASCII equations are not a canonical common mathematical encoding; ratios describe the exact declared text representations.
